title: What Does "Now" Mean to Your Computer-Use Agent? Stale Screenshots, Page Loads, and Which Check to Run Before a Click
why: Measures when CUA planned clicks go stale on real pages and which pre-click perception checks help.
mechanism: Evaluation/perception for computer-use agents: stale-click risk from page load vs planning delay; compares pixel pre-click checks vs VLM judges and open-source agent wait rules; break-even formula for check-or-skip
evaluation_signal: Author-reported (README Findings): on 31 public pages, 0.4% of clicks planned on fully loaded pages stale within 30s vs 17% within 1s of open; network-idle wait (median 1.2s) → 0.5%; pixel check detected 82% stale clicks at 4% FA in 0.3s; break-even decisions agreed with held-out data 95%. Numbers from README — no separate arXiv PDF; not independently verified.
